description: VYBE Music v5.0.0 - Official TERON TECH (IT Sector) Rebrand, Live GitHub Contributors Sync, Custom App Icon Storage Upload, and Admin App Info Management.
changelog: TERON TECH (IT Sector) Rebranding: Official repository and project startup ownership transitioned to TERON TECH with updated GPL v3.0 license and docs
Live GitHub Contributors: App dynamically synchronizes with GitHub repository contributors in real-time with LIVE indicator
Custom App Icon Manager: Deleted legacy preset icons, set official VYBE default, and enabled custom icon uploads from phone storage with admin deletion
Admin App Info & Social Links: Real-time in-app customization of startup name, repository links, version display overrides, and 1-tap contributor sync
Bug & Crash Fixes: Fixed settings/app_icon navigation graph crash, optimized Listen Together room sync, and refined Android 15/17 compatibility
